note: BH-9438: how many times the eject re-read (MC_EJECT_REREAD) may find the Mergify dequeue comments unreadable on one (PR, head) before it stops asking for that head. Each failure clears the ejreread mark so the next tick reads again; the failure that reaches this count keeps the mark, so a lasting outage costs this many reads, not one a tick. Settings row: lane.merge-conductor.mc_eject_reread_unread_max.
